referenceSchema: identical string ID schema for both arms; reference IDs only in condition-specific index
tokenAccounting: Provider-reported cumulative input + output + cache tokens. Checked on streaming usage and before next request/tool; input usage may arrive after a request is admitted. Any overshoot is explicitly reported. Per-response output capped at remaining budget and 12000.
costAccounting: Pi catalog estimates, not billing receipts; raw provider usage is archived.
